name: Agent manager
author: Brett
description: Create, edit, manage and orchestrate AI agents built from personas, lingo, skills and tools, each with its own persistent memory. Wizards for agents, skills, tools, an all-in-one agent builder and training (Firecrawl, web pages, the repo, MCP). Add-on agents: coder (React/TS/Python), AXF expert, AI expert. Works with the AI assistant when both are installed.
